description: A catchment area definition for a store or location. Defines the geographic area from which a store draws customers. Three methods are supported: isochrone inputs (travel time + transport mode, platform resolves the shape), simple radius (distance from location), or pre-computed GeoJSON geometry (buyer provides the exact boundary). Provide exactly one method per catchment.

catchment_id.description: Identifier for this catchment, used to reference specific catchment areas in targeting (e.g., 'walk', 'drive', 'primary').

ext.description: Extension object for platform-specific, vendor-namespaced parameters. Extensions are always optional and must be namespaced under a vendor/platform key (e.g., ext.gam, ext.roku). Used for custom capabilities, partner-specific configuration, and features being proposed for standardization.
ext.title: Extension Object

geometry.description: Pre-computed GeoJSON geometry defining the catchment boundary. Use this when the buyer has already calculated isochrones (via TravelTime, Mapbox, etc.) or has custom trade area boundaries. Supports Polygon and MultiPolygon types.

coordinates.description: GeoJSON coordinates array. For Polygon: array of linear rings. For MultiPolygon: array of polygons.

label.description: Human-readable label for this catchment (e.g., '15-min drive', '1km walking radius').

radius.description: Simple radius from the store location. The platform draws a circle of this distance around the store's coordinates.

transport_mode.description: Transportation mode for isochrone calculation. Required when travel_time is provided.

enumDescriptions.cycling: Bicycle travel on roads and cycle paths
enumDescriptions.driving: Motor vehicle travel on road networks
enumDescriptions.public_transport: Public transit including bus, rail, metro, and ferry
enumDescriptions.walking: Pedestrian travel on walkable paths and sidewalks

transport_mode.title: Transport Mode

travel_time.description: Travel time limit for isochrone calculation. The platform resolves this to a geographic boundary based on actual transportation networks, accounting for road connectivity, transit schedules, and terrain.

unit.description: Time unit for isochrone (travel-time catchment) calculations.
unit.title: Travel Time Unit

title: Catchment
